title: New York city amendments to the New York state energy code.
officialText:
The following New York city amendments to the New York state energy code are hereby adopted as set forth in Sections 28-1001.2.1 and 28-1001.2.2.

(L.L. 2015/004, 1/8/2015, eff. 1/1/2015; Am. L.L. 2016/091, 8/3/2016, eff. 10/3/2016; Am. L.L. 2020/048, 3/29/2020, eff. 5/12/2020; Am. L.L. 2026/047, 1/17/2026, retro. eff. 12/31/2025)
